trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in production with an 18% error rate across all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: to v2.3.0 in all regions. The first attempt failed with a partial orchestrator error (us-east only); a retry completed the rollout successfully. Post-rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api documenting the failure, the rollback, the partial-failure retry, and the current healthy state — the on-call engineer has been paged. Root cause of the v2.3.1 regression still needs investigation before redeploying.
